newsitem.title: USA: 3Com names top execs to run new groups.
newsitem.headline: 3Com names top execs to run new groups.

text.p: 3Com Corp, one of the leading makers of computer networking equipment, said Tuesday Bob Finocchio will run its new systems group and Doug Spreng will head the new personal products division.

Late Tuesday, 3Com unveiled a major restructuring at the company, centering its operations around two operating divisions, 3Com Systems and 3Com Personal Products, in an effort to focus more clearly on customer needs.
Previously, 3Com had organized around product groups. The new systems group will focus on large clients while personal products will emphasis small business and consumer markets.

Finocchio, who currently heads the company's systems business, becomes president 3Com Systems with responsiblity creating and marketing products for telephone companies, network service providers and other large enterprises.

Alan Kessler, vice president of customer service, will join Finocchio as senior vice president global systems sales, Ron Sege will also join the systems group as senior vice president and general manager of local area network (LAN) operations. Jim Olson becomes Sege's counterpart responsible for wide area network (WAN) products.
Spreng has been named executive vice president at the helm of 3Com Personal Products with its emphasis on consumer sales and high-volume networking products
Ralph Godfrey, an integral member of 3Com's North American sales group, has joined the new personal products division as senior vice president of global channel sales.
